text:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered (SEV2) — elevated 500s on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 for customer acct acme-eu. Error rate ~32% over last 5m. Paging oncall.

alice_sre: oncall here. seeing 500s with payloads that look like embedding requests. grabbing the first bad trace now.

maya_ml: I can join — those logs usually mean fallback landed on a variant that doesn't support embed APIs. Can you paste the resolver logs from the request path?

alice_sre: paste: ```
2026-03-15T10:05:12Z resolver: route_request id=xyz user=acme-eu model_pin=redwood-instruct-v2 variant=chat-instruct-v2 fallback_taken=true
2026-03-15T10:05:12Z runtime: dispatch id=xyz target_variant=chat-instruct-v2 endpoint=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T10:05:12Z runtime: handler_error id=xyz type=unsupported_request msg="embed endpoint not available for variant"
```

jon_runtime: that log is the smoking gun — requests with embed intent routed to chat-instruct-v2. The routing policy should have matched an embed-capable variant. Looks like a model-pin override for some deployment rolled out a pin that only has chat/generate endpoints.

alice_sre: how widespread? metrics show errors concentrated in eu-west-1 and primarily for the acme-eu project key.

leo_platform: rolling config note: at 10:00 we pushed a pin bundle (pin id pb-449) to EU region to force a performance variant for some customers. It was scoped to a list of model ids but looks like the variant mapping for "embed" intent was omitted for redwood-instruct-v2.

maya_ml: ok that explains it. When router can't find embed-compatible variant it falls back to compatible architecture (chat/instruct) per current fallback policy, which results in runtime errors because embed calls expect different model head. We need a mitigation path: either rollback the pin or patch the fallback to use a generic embed proxy.

alice_sre: initial mitigation: I'm going to temporarily disable pb-449 in eu-west-1. Doing now.

deploy-bot: disable-pin pb-449 eu-west-1 — started

deploy-bot: disable-pin pb-449 eu-west-1 — success (10:08:21Z)

alice_sre: disabled. can folks confirm error rates dropping?

jon_runtime: checking metrics — 5m after disable error rate dropped from 32% -> 4%. Latency normalized.

sara_custsuccess: we received an angry ping from acme-eu contact at 10:10 — they saw failures in their nightly sync job. I've sent an acknowledgement and told them we're actively mitigating and will follow up with timeline.

maya_ml: long term fix options:
- patch pin-bundle validation to require explicit variant maps for each intent (embed/gen/chat)
- update resolver to prefer embed-capable fallback variants, not chat-style variants
- add a test in the rollout pipeline to simulate embed requests during pin pressure tests

leo_platform: immediate next steps I will take:
1) Add a preflight validator to reject pin bundles missing intent->variant mapping (will roll a hotfix to platform at 10:40)
2) Backfill pb-449 metadata and re-run in canary with embed traffic only.

jon_runtime: also going to add a guard in the runtime to return 409 with a clearer message if an embed request hits a non-embed variant instead of 500, so downstream clients can handle gracefully. I'll open the PR now.

alice_sre: tagging this SEV2 -> response: mitigated. Rolling to postmortem. Please hold any config re-application until we have the validator in place.

deploy-bot: pr opened by jon_runtime: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/merge_requests/5123

maya_ml: note for postmortem — impact window: 10:02 -> 10:08 (6m) for bulk failures, some delayed retries extended customer-visible failure to ~10:15. Affected customers: acme-eu (primary), two other EU test tenants small spike.

sara_custsuccess: I will follow up with an incident summary + apology + offer to run a private embedding re-ingest for acme-eu on our dedicated infra.

alice_sre: any outstanding action items before I close the pager?

leo_platform: tasks:
- platform: 1) validator hotfix (ETA 11:15), 2) backfill pb-449 metadata and canary (ETA today EOD).
- runtime: 1) PR to change 500 -> 409 + clearer log (jon) (ETA 2h), 2) add telemetry to catch when fallback maps to incompatible variant (maya) (ETA tomorrow).
- cs: 1) customer comms (sara) (ETA 30m).

jon_runtime: starting a short-lived feature flag to fail fast for embed->non-embed mismatch and returning structured error so SDKs can surface better messages.

alice_sre: closing pager — mitigated (pin disabled). Marking follow-ups and assigning owners. We'll run postmortem with timeline and root cause (missing intent mapping in pin bundle) tomorrow at 11:00.

sara_custsuccess: ack, will prepare email draft for acme-eu and copy on PM notes.

maya_ml: adding one more note for postmortem — check rollout automation for region-specific overrides; the pin was intended for a subset of infra but scope expanded to eu-west-1 due to a packaging bug.

alice_sre: thanks team. end of thread.
